candidate_name: Ethiopia–Djibouti oil & gas export corridor (Dangote / Ethiopian Investment Holdings)
sponsor_or_proposer: Dangote Group + Ethiopian Investment Holdings (EIH) + Govts of Ethiopia & Djibouti
current_state: MoU/partnership announced May 2026; two-phase pipeline corridor (refined products to Ethiopia; later crude + natural-gas export pipelines via Djibouti). NO LNG liquefaction/export terminal announced — conventional pipelines + Damerjog liquid-bulk fuel depot only.
missing_threshold_elements: No LNG/liquefaction component (it is a gas/crude pipeline corridor, not an LNG terminal); no terminal-specific location/capacity for any liquefaction facility; no concrete construction step for an LNG export terminal.
watch_for: Any LNG liquefaction or LNG-export-terminal component attaching to the Dangote/EIH corridor; FID or construction start on a gas-export terminal at/near Damerjog; whether this corridor ever revives the cancelled Poly-GCL Damerjog FLNG concept.
notes: Distinct from the cancelled Djibouti FLNG Terminal (T100000130667). Brief flagged not to conflate Ethiopia gas routed via a separate proposed terminal — this corridor is that separate concept and currently lacks any LNG-terminal element. Bloomberg (2026-05-22) corroborates but FAILED url gate (403/paywall), so not cited.
